subject: general
question: The All India Services in India are created under which Article of the Constitution?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 312**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 312** of the Indian Constitution provides for the creation of **All India Services**, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and others.
 
• It empowers the **Parliament** to create All India Services if it deems necessary in the national interest.
 
• Such a decision can be made only after a **resolution** is passed by the **Council of States (Rajya Sabha)** by a majority of not less than two-thirds of the members present and voting.
 
• All India Services officers serve both the **Central Government** and the **State Governments**, ensuring administrative uniformity across the country.
 
• The objective of Article 312 is to maintain a strong and efficient administrative framework across India.
 
• These services are often referred to as the "steel frame" of the nation due to their role in upholding governance and national unity.
 
• Examples of All India Services include the **Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS).**
 
• Article 312 is located in **Part XIV** of the Indian Constitution, which deals with services under the Union and States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 320**__

 __
 
• **Article 320** pertains to the functions of the **Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** and State Public Service Commissions.
 
• It includes conducting **examinations** for appointments to civil services and posts.
 
• The commissions are also responsible for advising on matters like **disciplinary action, promotions, and recruitment**.
 
 
 
• **Article 206**__
 __
 
• **Article 206** in the Indian Constitution relates to provisions about the **expenditure charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India.**
 
• It specifically deals with matters of **budgetary allocation** and grants.
 
• It does not pertain to the creation of All India Services.
 
 
 
• **Article 107**__
 
 
• **Article 107** deals with the **legislative procedure** concerning bills in Parliament.
 
• It explains the process of introduction and passage of bills in both houses of the Parliament.
 
• This article is unrelated to the establishment of All India Services.
